text:
Maya K: Quick sync — we need a concise SEO plan for the webinar launch + follow-up blog. Focus: search visibility day-of, clean redirects, schema for the event, and proper lead routing.
Tim S: +1. Can we list the priority technical tasks and measurement plan?
Maya K: Priority I see: 1) keyword target list for webinar + blog, 2) Event schema + FAQ schema, 3) canonical/duplicate content rules, 4) redirect sweep (301 chains), 5) internal linking from product pages, 6) inbound lead UTM -> CRM mapping, 7) monitoring & benchmarks.
Lena R: For keywords — create 3 buckets: (a) branded+webinar, (b) intent (e.g., "reduce LLM inference cost"), (c) educational longtails (how-to). We should map one primary + 2 supporting per page.
Tim S: I’ll draft the keyword sheet and suggested on-page H1/H2s. Also add meta descriptions variations for A/B messaging.
Carlos V: Redirect sweep — we found two old event pages still indexed that cause 301 chains. I'll drop a sample mapping and nginx rule for the infra team to apply.
Carlos V: ```csv
old_path,new_path,action
/events/2023-redwood-ai,/webinars/2026-inference-economics,301
/blog/old-benchmarks,/blog/benchmark-inference-costs,301
```
Carlos V: ```nginx
# fix legacy 301 chains
location /events/2023-redwood-ai {
  return 301 https://www.redwood.inference/webinars/2026-inference-economics;
}
# catch common old blog slugs
rewrite ^/blog/old-benchmarks$ /blog/benchmark-inference-costs permanent;
```
Maya K: Nice. Also need canonical rules on the blog: prefer /blog/{slug} and strip query params for canonical where possible. 
Lena R: For schema: use Event schema on webinar landing, include startDate, endDate, location (online), offers (if any), and add FAQPage schema for the top 5 Qs. We'll include JSON-LD in the head. Example snippet: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Inference Economics Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-20T16:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled"}
```
Tim S: Messaging iteration: we'll run two headline variants on the landing page for the first 48 hours and use GA4 conversion_rate + CR from the registration form as the tie-breaker. Add utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=launch, utm_campaign=inf-econ-may2026.
Maya K: Lead routing: ensure form -> HubSpot mapping includes utm params + hidden field for landing_id. If we have UTM -> lifecycle stage automation, trigger MQL when utm_campaign matches.
Lena R: Preflight SEO QA checklist for launch day: sitemap updated, event page included, robots.txt unchanged, canonical tags present, structured data validated (Rich Results Test), redirects applied, 301 chain test, Google Search Console URL submit.
Tim S: Benchmarks to capture before launch: current organic clicks for related queries, avg position for target keywords, baseline blog conversion rate, crawl errors. Post-launch: impressions, clicks, CTR, registrations, time-to-index.
Maya K: Can someone own the post-launch monitor window (72 hrs)? Need watch for indexing issues and unexpected 404s. @Lena R can you take the 0-24h?
Lena R: I can do 0-24 and compile a quick heatmap of which internal pages link to the webinar landing.
Carlos V: I’ll confirm the redirect deploy and run Screaming Frog on the staging mirror after changes. Will ping when done.
seo-bot: Reminder: scheduled sitemap ping to GSC at 2026-05-20T17:00Z after deploy.
Maya K: Perfect. Action owners: Tim = keywords + meta variants, Lena = schema + 0-24h monitor, Carlos = redirects + crawl QA, Maya = messaging + lead mapping. We'll reconvene 24h after launch. :rocket:
